title: Provide a paginated memory stream query
head: Commit containing this receipt; exact published head and normal hook results recorded in the PR description.

dependencies.stack: User-requested F stack on corrected F16; F18 is an optional synchronous read interface, with no unmerged implementation imported.

baseline_review.comparison: Both source blobs are identical on pinned audit, inspected main and corrected F16. No existing F17 branch or PR at start. F18 card reviewed to define supplied/selected/outcome-verified seam.
baseline_review.parent_ci: All active corrected F16 checks pass; conditional jobs skipped.

figma.visual: Backend read API only. No UI activation or screenshot claimed.

activation.dependency: Exact registered and enabled F18 memoryUsage reader required. No production reader exists on this branch, so the stream flag alone stays unavailable.

implementation: Authenticated read-only collection/detail/history routes preserve canonical IDs, confirmation precedence, status, validity and provenance without changing legacy routes or writers.
Bounded literal sentence search, exact provenance Source, explicit conversation/run Used in, half-open Updated filters and exact total/matched/returned counts.
Five-minute signed query-bound cursors freeze membership/counts across same-time and backdated inserts. Canonical changes invalidate with stale/no cached data; refresh sees new facts.
Default-off registration and optional F18 ledger read seam; missing instrumentation is null, available empty ledger is unused, selected-only records never match Used in.
Safe local detail/history links follow retained canonical supersession edges only; no quotes, raw source references, arbitrary usage fields, textual attribution or model reliance claim.
Bounded rows/bytes/snapshots/history with unavailable instead of silent truncation. No schema changes or new truth engine.

mutations.restoration: Original bytes restored in finally; fresh focused suite passes afterward.

verification.manual: Isolated temporary SQLite vaults plus real authenticated Unix-socket requests. A second SQLite connection inserts between page requests. Restart, stale deletion/correction, exact count combinations, safe lineage, caps and legacy compatibility exercised. No live service, model or desktop effect.
verification.guards: Normal commit hooks required before push; final hook result is recorded in the PR.

limitations: No F18 production ledger and no live D20 room adapter. The stream is not release-enabled by this PR.
Updated uses existing creation/verification/provenance timestamps; revision hashes still detect changes without a timestamp. History is retained supersession lineage, not every in-place edit.
Search covers subject/predicate/object text, Source is a label and sourceId is unknown. Active/contested time-limited facts remain browsable with explicit validity; this is not recall eligibility.

At most 10000 facts including history, 50000 evidence and 50000 usage records; separate 16 MiB facts/evidence and usage serialized input caps. Larger vaults fail closed and need a scalable query implementation before activation.
Sixteen five-minute snapshots per daemon provider; expiry/restart/eviction requires refresh. Original-member changes invalidate the snapshot; unrelated inserts wait for refresh.
No UI, mutation endpoints, ledger writer, external provider calls or F18 implementation. Full repository CI reports separately on the PR.
rollback: Unset JARVIS_BRIEF_MEMORY_STREAM or disable memoryUsage. No schema migration or canonical data deletion is needed.
